title: DollJoint 솔로 #051 · hourglass bombshell · 벚나무 마리오네트 청록 관절 · 머리 넘기기 · 미니멀 로프트 · 클래식 레드립 극한
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a deep ebony-brown complexion, early 50s goddess, hourglass bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, hips AND bust simultaneously flaring to absolute maximum, thighs pressing together, every curve maximized at once, top bun lavender hair — full body carved honey-beech wooden marionette fused directly to her own form covering EVERY inch of skin from neck to ankle WITHOUT EXCEPTION, both legs FULLY covered to ankles, NO bare skin below neck ANYWHERE — this is not a garment, not jewelry, not a printed pattern, this is a solid carved beechwood body curving to follow her body's true three-dimensional shape, divided into smooth fitted wooden segments, and at her neck, shoulders, elbows, wrists, hips, knees and ankles every segment ends in a round exposed ball joint seated in its socket with a thin dark gap and its own small shadow, nothing lying flat. Dense fitted segments — BLAZING warm honey-gold beechwood grain across the full torso both legs neck to ankle, VIVID bright teal-blue painted ball joints standing out sharply against the honey-gold wood, thin taut strings running from her head, shoulders, elbows, wrists, hips and knees straight up out of the top of the frame, hand-waxed satin, completely opaque, NO airbrush NO gradient wash, NO flat printed surface anywhere. Pose: one hand sweeping her hair back, the other resting on her hip, one leg crossed in front to show the boot — most extreme hourglass bombshell silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, thigh-high platform stiletto boots made of the same carved beechwood, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, curved talon nails each longer than her middle finger, made of the same carved beechwood with a high polish.
Jewelry: sculpted gold armbands high on both upper arms, a long layered gold necklace falling between her breasts, and a pearl choker and a long strand of pearls hanging low on her chest. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body, nothing added to her face or ears.
Face: her face and ears are NOT part of the doll body — they are real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Black woman with strong, striking features, a broad nose and full lips, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: pushed to the absolute extreme: thick lacquer-glossy saturated pillar-box red lips overlined fuller than natural, a razor-sharp long winged liner, dramatic lashes, a flawless matte complexion with sculpted cheekbones.

Background: a bright minimalist loft studio with pale concrete floors, tall factory windows, a standard door and a row of standard-height steps, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, NO dark background NO black void, completely empty of other people, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as her. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on every surface texture and shadow. Pattern density MAXIMUM — zero bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the boots to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the boot soles from the floor. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
